events.description: A large group of protesters engages in violent unrest, throwing objects, overturning barriers, and clashing with police; the scene escalates to include fire and smoke near a police water cannon vehicle.
Multiple individuals are seen in close physical confrontation, grappling and striking each other amid the crowd; some appear to be using sticks or poles as weapons.
Protesters throw stones and firecrackers at a police water cannon vehicle; flames and smoke erupt on the ground in front of the vehicle as riot police in full gear advance.

Large crowd of demonstrators, many holding red flags and banners, actively engage in violent confrontation with police, using makeshift shields and throwing objects; scene shows chaotic group clashes during a protest against pension reforms.

A large group of demonstrators, many holding red flags and wearing masks, are actively engaged in violent unrest: they are seen tearing apart and throwing large black panels (likely barriers or stage parts) toward police lines, with aggressive postures and coordinated actions indicating collective violent confrontation.

Police in riot gear deploy a water cannon against a crowd of protesters; the high-pressure jet is clearly visible striking the crowd and building facade, while protesters raise hands and shields, indicating an active violent clash between state forces and demonstrators.

A sudden burst of fire and smoke erupts at the base of a police vehicle (number 9049), consistent with an explosive device detonating—flames appear instantaneously and expand outward rapidly, distinct from sustained burning.

Police in riot gear deploy water cannons against a crowd of demonstrators during a protest; the water jet is visibly striking protesters and creating large sprays, indicating violent dispersal tactics.

After the water cannon deployment ceases, police remain in formation facing the crowd; smoke or mist lingers, and protesters continue to confront officers, sustaining a tense standoff indicative of ongoing unrest.
Police in riot gear stand amid smoke and debris on a street; crowd is visible behind barriers, suggesting ongoing unrest or confrontation.
Police in riot gear confront a crowd of protesters holding large red banners (including 'PST' and 'MST'), with water cannons deployed and visible spray, indicating violent unrest and group clashes.
Two large fires burning on a city street, producing thick black smoke; consistent with arson during civil unrest, likely resulting from the preceding confrontation.
Police in riot gear deploy water cannons against a crowd of protesters holding large red banners (including 'PST' and 'MST'), indicating violent group clashes.
Sustained street fire with large flames and thick black smoke, consistent with burning barricades or tires during unrest; no active firefighting visible.

Aftermath scene showing debris-strewn street, people standing near burned remnants, with the National Congress building in background—indicating continuation of violent unrest following earlier clashes and fires.
Sustained street fire with large flames and thick black smoke in an urban setting, consistent with deliberate burning during civil unrest; people visible in background near burning objects.

Crowd gathered in front of a government building (Congressional Palace), with debris and a large stone block in foreground; people moving actively, some appearing to confront or occupy the space—contextual evidence of ongoing unrest following earlier clashes.
